_comment: Copy to bridge.json (never committed) and fill in. twitch: the channel's name is enough to read its chat; oauth_token and nick only for a chat closed to guests. youtube: api_key of your own Google Cloud project with YouTube Data API v3 on, and video_id of the live broadcast (the part after watch?v=). min_interval_seconds keeps the polls within the daily quota: each costs 5 of 10 000 units. telegram: bot_token of your own bot (@BotFather, privacy off or the bot an admin), chats the groups to hear (their ids, as the bridge's log shows them, or @usernames); accept_slash takes «/моё» as «!моё»; the bot answers «!помощь», «!правила», /help and /start with the rules (rules: a list of lines, empty for the built-in ones), in a group once a rules_gap_seconds. game: where the game listens (reserve.json link).
